$comment: copy-guard spec v2, qasem-portal-web (Next.js, English only). All user-facing copy lives in src as TS/TSX (pages, components, src/lib data, metadata, JSON-LD, OG cards, email text); .js/.jsx/.mjs are included because tsconfig allows JS. public/ holds SVG brand marks plus raster images today; the SVGs are scanned as markup, and the text and JSON surfaces make sure an llms.txt, web manifest or similar file added later is checked too (until then they print a harmless 'matches no tracked file' warning).
